name: The Anchors of Zephras
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Greetings, young adventurer. I often times come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.
narrative.requestItemsText: My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the ley lines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it.Appreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.
